metadata.label: positive
metadata.reference: A photorealistic minimalist living room with a single large window on the left wall, sunlight entering at a forty-five degree angle, casting perfectly aligned and proportionally correct shadows from a coffee table, a ceramic vase, and a lounge chair onto the floor and opposite wall, no extra text or watermarks.
metadata.rationale: Every shadow originates from the single window light source and maintains geometrically accurate angles and lengths.
